name: daiji-sshr-redmine-mcp-stateless
description: Stateless Redmine MCP server. Credentials are passed per-request via HTTP headers and never stored on the server. Supports listing/creating/updating issues, full-text search across subjects, descriptions and comments, and editing journals (Redmine 5.0+). Deployable on RHEL (systemd) or Docker.
install:
# git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/daiji-sshr/redmine-mcp-stateless
# See source for mcpServers config block
